_comment: Approved HIGH-severity vulnerability exceptions. A HIGH finding with a valid (non-expired) entry here reports WARN instead of FAIL. CRITICAL findings can never be excepted here -- gate.js treats any blocking CRITICAL FAIL as an automatic NO-GO regardless of this file. Expiry is checked programmatically against the run date; an expired entry reports FAIL, no manual override.

_schema.reason: why this is being accepted temporarily
_schema.owner: who approved this / is tracking the fix
_schema.expiry: YYYY-MM-DD -- after this date the exception no longer applies
